pkgmetadata.longdescription: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI assistant that orchestrates skills, cron jobs, messaging gateways, and providers. Upstream ships it via a shell installer, a Docker image or Nix; this ebuild builds it as a normal Python package against the interpreter and dependencies in the tree, and installs the bundled locale, skill and MCP-catalog trees under /usr/share/hermes-agent, wired up through /etc/env.d/99hermes-agent.

use.flag: Enable the Azure Entra ID provider (dev-python/azure-identity).
Enable the Model Context Protocol client SDK (dev-python/mcp, GURU) for 'hermes mcp login' and the computer_use stdio client.
Enable OTLP-over-HTTP monitoring export (opentelemetry-sdk plus the proto-http exporter).
Enable speech-to-text for CLI voice mode via the local, offline faster-whisper engine (dev-python/faster-whisper) plus dev-python/sounddevice audio capture -- no cloud API key needed.
Require media-video/ffmpeg built with USE=lame, the MP3 encoder Hermes' text-to-speech delivery path shells out to ffmpeg for. Without it TTS fails at runtime, not merge time.
Build the Ink/React terminal UI (esbuild bundle). Requires network access during src_compile for 'npm ci', so it lifts network-sandbox.
Build the Vite/React web dashboard. Requires network access during src_compile for 'npm ci', so it lifts network-sandbox.
